4.name: City of Brotherly Love
4.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

4.name: Cage Fight
4.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

4.name: One Small Step
4.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

4.name: Karambits and Pieces
4.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

4.name: Bridge
4.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

4.name: Plum Out of Luck
4.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

4.name: Vote for Sampson
4.overview: Reacher and Tamara finally get the answers they've been looking for. Meanwhile, Jacob learns that their problems are just beginning when Plum's sources come through with some timely information.

4.name: Cut
4.overview: Reacher, Tamara and Jacob take the fight to the enemy as the full extent of their plot is revealed. Reacher faces off with those responsible for Anna's death while Jacob faces a moment of truth and Plum gets his shot at redemption.

overview: ریچر؛ سریالی در ژانر جنایی مهیج محصول سرویس ویدئویی آمازون است. سریال بر اساس رُمان قتلگاه نوشتهٔ لی چایلد و با بازی آلن ریچسون در نقش اصلی است. تام کروز سابقا در دو فیلم نقش جک ریچر را ایفا کرده بود. یک کهنه سرباز پرافتخار به نام جک ریچر با ادعای شاهدان صحنه‌ جنایت، به جرم قتل در یک شهر کوچک متهم و دستگیر می‌شود. به همین دلیل جک ریچر تلاش می‌کند تا بی‌گناهی خود را با یافتن قاتل حقیقی ثابت کند و از این جرم بی‌پایه و اساس تبرئه شود اما…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on "Bad Luck and Trouble," when members of Reacher's old military unit start turning up dead, Reacher has just one thing on his mind—revenge.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

title: Reacher
